verdict.rationale: A GPU can plausibly be used headless for compute or CI workloads, so the axis applies. However, no evidence documents headless or CI operation of the RTX 5080. The CUDA toolkit and NGC CUDA containers are developer building blocks for building GPU applications, not a documented headless or CI automation capability of the product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
